title: hydnocarpus calophyllus
intro: Hydnocarpus calophyllus, commonly known as the Chiraito plant, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Alismataceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hydnocarpus calophyllus include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include hydnocarpin, hydnocarpic acid, and other glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
